_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/mana/test_tapped_for.py. t_c_monument is Forsaken Monument's second line alone: add_mana_on_tap with tapped_for '{C}' and no tapped_permanent, so any permanent tapped for {C} counts. t_c_or_g_rock taps for {C} or {G}, so the static is shown to be asked per option rather than per permanent. t_five_rock costs {5}, castable off a Sol Ring and a Wastes only with the extra mana.
